title: Run full security and dependency review
description: Perform a release security review over changed code, dependencies, CI, installer, artifact path, auth/SSRF boundaries, and secret handling.
acceptanceCriteria: A fresh independent review finds no unresolved critical/high issue
Dependency audit and workflow/action review are recorded with disposition
Static scans cover added/changed code for secrets, shell injection, path traversal, unsafe deserialization/eval, and dangerous process execution
All findings have an owner, severity, fix/waiver decision, and regression test where code changed

steps.details: Scan the relevant diff and changed files for hardcoded secrets, shell injection, path traversal, eval/exec, unsafe deserialization, and sensitive logging.
Run `npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high`; record exact result and do not suppress high findings without disposition.
Inspect permissions, action refs, download URLs, checksum/attestation gates, archive extraction, and rollback paths.
Have a fresh reviewer inspect the final diff and security evidence; remediate and re-review until approved or formally waived.

technicalNotes: No token, password, SSH key, cookie, or env value may appear in the review request or evidence.
